prompt_reference.prompt: Titan Gates non-playable campaign character concept art: Mesha Gate-Scribe. Tall ceremonial scribe silhouette in gold-lacquered linen armor, obsidian stylus, sun-disc visor, amber-glowing tablet. Faction/culture: Aten Ra. Visual identity: Gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber Radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms.. Role: Lore witness and Codex keeper. Dark tactical mythological fantasy, mobile game character card, painterly detail, full body, strong silhouette, no sci-fi. Faction Visual Bible: follow Aten Ra material hierarchy, armor shape language, symbols, texture rules, and avoid list from TG-FVB-001; faction canon must be visible in silhouette, materials, and posture. Canon premise: this place/character comes from the Solar Dominion of Khepra, the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth. Show Aten hand-rays, Ma’at geometry, Nile/Red Land duality, electrum, linen-light, faience, lapis, obsidian, scarab/lotus/papyrus/falcon/cobra/lion symbols only where mythically appropriate. Canon premise: this is the source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth; Earth legend is the echo and the Solar Dominion of Khepra is the original.
prompt_reference.negative_prompt: sci-fi, futuristic craft, guns, extradimensional beings, modern city, superhero costume, photorealistic celebrity, cute cartoon, low detail, blurry, text, watermark, logo, robot armor, cube bodies, literal pyramid body, building windows, neon sci-fi, tourist pharaoh costume, generic Egyptian cosplay, readable glyph text, robot armor, sarcophagus robot

quality_gates: Mobile-readable silhouette at card and battlefield preview scale.
Every faction asset must visibly follow data/faction-visual-bible.json for silhouette, armor construction, material hierarchy, symbols, textures, and faction-specific avoid rules.
Titans must read as living extradimensional mythic beings, not robots, mechs, androids, or humans in powered armor.
Titans must keep readable living anatomy and character silhouette; reject blocky buildings, tower bodies, fortress torsos, stacked geometric shapes, or architecture piles masquerading as Titans.
No sci-fi firearms, futuristic craft, modern corporate UI, generic superhero styling, watermarks, or readable generated text.
Faction identity must remain unmistakable: material language, realm symbols, culture, and role silhouette must agree with canon.
Generated image may not be marked imported until a real asset file exists in the artwork pipeline.
Mesha remains non-playable campaign support; art may not imply a playable Hero class.
The First Reopening Gate must read as physical broken Gatefield terrain, not a neon board-game tile set.
rejection_triggers: Faction drift: asset lacks the faction visual bible material/symbol/silhouette language or uses an avoid-listed trope.
Robot, mecha, android, cyborg, transformer, or powered-suit read.
Blocky building, tower, fortress, cube-stack, abstract geometry pile, or literal architecture-body read.
Sci-fi armor, firearms, vehicle parts, visible pistons, hydraulic joints, or spaceship aesthetic.
Loss of mobile readability in 360px vertical crop.
Visual contradiction of prompt negativePrompt constraints.
